data.action: 单膝抵在潮湿砂石上，单手扶稳大剑剑柄，侧身望向灰紫暮色
data.camera: low angle, medium shot, 低机位中景，大剑插于黑砂与浪花同框
data.description: 暴风雨后的伊比利亚暗礁滩，狂浪撞击着嶙峋黑石。斯卡蒂单膝抵在潮湿黑砂上，单手按住深海大剑的剑柄，任由咸涩的浪沫打在脸颊。她没有看身后的恐鱼残骸，只是静静望着海平面微弱的暮光——「海风很冷，你该回去了。别离我太近……」
data.lighting: 暴风雨后天际微弱的灰紫暮色冷光
data.promptProse: On a bleak rocky coastline after a violent storm, Skadi kneels on one knee upon wet dark sand, holding her massive greatsword planted firmly beside her. A cold sea breeze whips her long silver hair as twilight settles over crashing waves in muted purple and grey tones.
data.title: 斯卡蒂 · 深渊海岸的独行残响
data.animaCaption: Kneeling on one knee upon the wet shore with her greatsword planted in the sand, she gazes toward the dimming horizon under the cool twilight sky.
